newsitem.title: INDIA: India to raise 97/98 domestic fertiliser subsidy.
newsitem.headline: India to raise 97/98 domestic fertiliser subsidy.

text.p: India said on Friday it will raise the subsidy on domestic fertilisers to 52.4 billion rupees in 1997/98 (April-March) from 47.4 billion in the previous fiscal year.
The subsidy on sale of "decontrolled fertilisers" would be enhanced to 20 billion rupees in 1997/98 from 16.74 billion in the revised estimate for 1996/97, Chidambaram said.
He was referring to some pottasic and phosphatic fertilisers, whose prices are not controlled by the government and are determined by market forces.
